prompt: Which category does this call belong to?
about: One question: the category of the call. The model picks one option; every option carries a verdict, so the probability the model puts on the scam options is the call's P(scam). The options are the categories found in the transcripts of the dataset below, described from reading calls of each one. Scam and legitimate options alternate so that a preference for early letters cannot line up with one verdict.

options.text: Social Security: the caller says there is a problem with the person's Social Security number or benefits and asks them to verify details
Delivery: a delivery company calling to confirm a package, an address or a delivery time
Refund: the caller says the person is owed a refund for a purchase or charge and needs details to send it
Insurance: an insurance company offering a policy, a quote or a discount
Computer support: the caller says the person's computer has a virus or a problem and offers to fix it
Sales: a company offering a product or a service
Prize or reward: the caller says the person has won or been chosen for a gift card or a prize
Wrong number: the caller meant to reach someone else
